manifest.scope: read-only mask-failure localisation; no training, no checkpoint writes
manifest.rule: from the training windows of build_train_entries (plan stride 750, one per scene), rank thing instances by best-over-groups IoU at mask>0.5 / area>=50 (GT-assisted, no score gate) using the reference checkpoint; take the 4 lowest-IoU mid instances (1310<=mean per-view GT area<6553) and the 4 lowest-IoU large instances (>=6553) that are visible in at least one novel view, plus the single highest-IoU instance as success reference.  Selected before any per-checkpoint analysis and not swapped.

provenance_legend.proven_trained_window: scene/context/novel tuple appears in the executed 6000-step train log (so it was really trained on)
provenance_legend.evaluation_window_of_training_scene: frames come from the plan for that training scene but are not in the log
